hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-none
hierarchy.overline: text-xs font-sans font-medium tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#C5A059]

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or generic sans for headings.
Always use tight letter spacing on headings, wide spacing on overlines.
NO pure black (#000000) or pure white (#FFFFFF). Use tinted charcoal (#0A0A09) and bone white (#EAE8E3).
NO purple gradients or generic SaaS palettes. Stick to Midnight & Brass (Luxury Archetype).
Use #C5A059 (muted gold) sparingly for primary CTAs and active states.

layouts.hero: Full-bleed cinematic hero section with bg-black/40 to bg-black/50 overlay. Text must be left-aligned or center-aligned with high dramatic contrast.
layouts.product_grid: Asymmetrical editorial grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Mix tall portrait cards (col-span-4 row-span-2) with square supporting cards.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-16, py-24 for section padding to allow the luxury feel to breathe.
layouts.surfaces: Crystal Glass for sticky headers: bg-[#0A0A09]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10. Flat, 1px bordered containers (border-[#EAE8E3]/10) for product cards.
rules: DO NOT use standard Bootstrap equal-column grids for marketing pages.
DO NOT use fully transparent backgrounds for navbars or drop-downs over content. Use glassmorphism or solid backgrounds.

components.buttons: Sharp (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm). Primary CTA: border border-[#C5A059] text-[#C5A059] hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-[#0A0A09] transition-colors duration-300.
components.cards: Cardless or flat geometric shapes. Image takes 80% of height. On hover: image scales up smoothly (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden container.
components.inputs: Shadcn based, but strictly styled: bg-transparent border-b border-white/20 rounded-none focus:border-[#C5A059].
components.language_switcher: Text-based dropdown (EN, DE, FR, ES, IT) in the header. No colorful flag icons. Use wide tracking.
components.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').

visual_enhancers.motion: Lenis for smooth scrolling (MANDATORY). Framer Motion for subtle fade-in-up (y: 20, opacity: 0) on scroll. Micro-interactions on buttons and product cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Optional subtle noise/grain overlay (mix-blend-overlay, opacity 5%) over the entire body to kill digital flatness and enhance the tactile 'fabric/spice' feel.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Product cards must reveal 'Add to Cart' or 'Quick View' subtly on hover. Text colors must shift with high contrast.

home_decor.description: Dark luxury dining setting with table runner

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI in React using standard .js extensions (not .tsx).
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for the main marketing/e-commerce layouts (grid, flex) to achieve editorial asymmetry.
Use Shadcn UI primarily for complex interactives (Forms, Modals, Dropdowns) but heavily customize them to match the dark/gold luxury theme.
Ensure standard components like Dropdowns use a solid background (#151413) instead of transparent to prevent readability issues over content.
Apply data-testid to all actionable items.
Use lucide-react for elegant, minimal icons.
Create a Multi-Language Dropdown in the header, keeping it minimal text (EN / DE / FR / ES / IT).
Integrate a toggleable or separate Admin Panel section for managing products, categories, and orders using Shadcn tables/cards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create depth with z-index hierarchy and layered shadows.
Do not apply `transition: all` globally. Target transitions specifically (e.g. `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).
Never center-align the main App container globally (`.App { text-align: center; }`).
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Use sonner for elegant toast notifications on cart additions.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment.
